A required unsuccessful revision is unknown with final null. A final revision requires both clean rechecks and evidence-backed closure of each prior serious finding by its originating lens. Source-visible completion does not establish native identity, retries, global admission or terminal/usage closure. The unchanged collector still checks committed workflow bytes, current SHA256SUMS, original agent-lab ancestry, role, prompt and launch/tree bindings before recording; this source correction supplies no native run receipt.
